tha-ap337:1.1: Vipassī nāma sambuddho lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / khīṇāsavehi sahito saṅghārāme vasī tadā. // //
tha-ap337:2.1: Ārāmadvārā nikkhamma Vipassī lokanāyako / sahasatasahassehi aṭṭha khīṇāsavehi tu. // //
tha-ap337:3.1: Ajinena* nivattho 'haṃ vāka*ciradharo pi ca / kusumbhodakam ādāya sambuddham upasaṅkamiṃ. // //
tha-ap337:4.1: Sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā vedajāto katañjali / kusumbhodakam ādāya Buddham abbhukkirim ahaṃ // //
tha-ap337:5.1: Tena kammena sambuddho jalajuttamanāmako / mama kammaṃ pakittetvā *agamā ye*na patthitaṃ. // //
tha-ap337:6.1: Phussitā pañcasahassā yehi pūjes' ahaṃ jinaṃ / aḍḍhateyyasahassehi devarajjam akārayiṃ. // //
tha-ap337:7.1: Aḍḍhateyyasahassehi cakkavattī ahos' ahaṃ / avasesena kammena arahattam apāpuṇiṃ. // //
tha-ap337:8.1: Devarājā yadā homi manujādhipati yathā / tam yeva nāmadheyyam me Phussito nāma hom' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap337:9.1: Devabhūtassa santassa athāpi mānusassa vā / samantāvyāmato mayhaṃ phussitaṃ va pavassati // //
tha-ap337:10.1: Bhavā ugghāṭitā mayhaṃ kilesā jhāpitā mama / sabbāsave parikkhīṇo phussitassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap337:11.1: Candanass' eva me vasso tathā gandho pavāyati / sārīriko mamaṃ gandho aḍḍhakose pavāyati. // //
tha-ap337:12.1: Dibbagandhaṃ sampavantaṃ puññakammasamaṅginaṃ / gandhaṃ ghatvāna jānanti Phussito āgato idha. // //
tha-ap337:13.1: Sākhā phalā sakaṭṭhāni tiṇāni pi va sabbaso / mama saṅkappam aññāya gandho sampajjate khaṇe. // //
tha-ap337:14.1: Satasahasse ito kappe candanam abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phussitassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap337:16.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Phussitakammiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
